```{r}
#| label: setup
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# Wilson interval for a binomial proportion.
wilson <- function(x, n, z = 1.96) {
  p <- x / n
  d <- 1 + z^2 / n
  c <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / d
  h <- (z / d) * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))
  c(lo = pmax(0, c - h), hi = pmin(1, c + h))
}
```

## 1. Introduction

- The previous post measured how often eligible college seasons end in an
  NFL outcome over the whole population at once; the draft itself, and any
  model of it, sorts players by position first.
- This post splits those seasons by the position the player lined up at in
  that season and checks four expectations a fan might bring to it:
  + *Quarterbacks are the most draftable position.*
  + *First-round picks concentrate among quarterbacks.*
  + *Quarterbacks are picked earliest on average, in every draft class.*
  + *Quarterbacks arrive through the draft while other positions lean on the
    undrafted route.*

## 2. Data

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-24. Draft classes
after the last complete draft are right-censored and carry no outcomes, so
they are excluded from every rate below rather than counted as failures.
Each season's position comes from the roster table, joined by athlete id
and season.*
:::

```{r}
#| label: load
# The connection message is an implementation detail; the reader sees only
# the counts in the visible chunks.
outcomes <- tbl(con, "outcomes") |> collect()
roster_pos <- tbl(con, "roster") |>
  # A few players carry two roster rows in one season (mid-season moves);
  # they always agree on the position, so one row per player-season is kept.
  select(playerId, season, position) |>
  distinct() |>
  collect()
dbDisconnect(con)

risk <- outcomes |>
  filter(draft_eligible, outcome_observed_d) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(outcome_drafted_d, outcome_signed_udfa_d, outcome_nfl_entry_d),
      ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE)
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(roster_pos, by = c("playerId", "season"))

pos_group <- c(
  QB = "Quarterback",
  RB = "Running back",
  FB = "Running back",
  WR = "Receiver",
  TE = "Tight end",
  T = "Offensive line",
  G = "Offensive line",
  C = "Offensive line",
  OL = "Offensive line",
  DL = "Defensive line",
  DE = "Defensive line",
  DT = "Defensive line",
  NT = "Defensive line",
  EDGE = "Defensive line",
  LB = "Linebacker",
  ILB = "Linebacker",
  OLB = "Linebacker",
  DB = "Defensive back",
  S = "Defensive back",
  CB = "Defensive back",
  PK = "Special teams",
  P = "Special teams",
  LS = "Special teams",
  PR = "Special teams"
)
n_risk_pre <- nrow(risk)
risk <- risk |>
  mutate(
    group = dplyr::coalesce(
      dplyr::recode(position, !!!pos_group, .default = "Position not recorded"),
      "Position not recorded"
    )
  )

n_risk <- nrow(risk)
n_players <- n_distinct(risk$playerId)
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
#| include: false
# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
comparable <- function(df) filter(df, group != "Position not recorded")
```

### Nine position groups stand in for two dozen roster codes

Each season is counted at the roster position listed for it, and neighboring
roster codes describing the same professional role are grouped into the
nine reader-facing groups below, plus a tenth for seasons with none
recorded.

```{r}
#| label: group-terms
group_terms <- tribble(
  ~Group                  , ~"Roster codes in the group"                                                                                    ,
  "Quarterback"           , "QB"                                                                                                            ,
  "Running back"          , "RB, FB"                                                                                                        ,
  "Receiver"              , "WR"                                                                                                            ,
  "Tight end"             , "TE"                                                                                                            ,
  "Offensive line"        , "T, G, C, OL"                                                                                                   ,
  "Defensive line"        , "DL, DE, DT, NT, EDGE"                                                                                          ,
  "Linebacker"            , "LB, ILB, OLB"                                                                                                  ,
  "Defensive back"        , "DB, S, CB"                                                                                                     ,
  "Special teams"         , "PK, P, LS, PR"                                                                                                 ,
  "Position not recorded" , "A placeholder code (?), a code outside the groups above (OT, ATH), or no roster row for that season at all"
)
kable(group_terms, caption = "Table 1: the position groups used throughout")
```

### The risk set is every eligible season whose draft outcome is already known

A **player-season** is one player's college season with a recorded stat
line, an **eligible** season is one whose following draft could have
selected the player, and the table below counts the
`r fmt(n_risk)` eligible seasons, from `r fmt(n_players)` players, behind
every rate in this post; each rate carries a 95 percent confidence
interval, the range the true rate plausibly occupies given how many
seasons were observed (Wilson's method, which behaves well for rare
events).

```{r}
#| label: risk-set
risk_set <- tibble(
  Measure = c("Eligible player-seasons", "Distinct players"),
  Count = fmt(c(n_risk, n_players))
)
kable(risk_set, caption = "Table 2: the risk set")
```

```{r}
#| label: grain-guard
#| include: false
# The guarded position join adds or drops no rows, and the outcome labels
# stay mutually exclusive after the join.
stopifnot(
  nrow(risk) == n_risk_pre,
  !any(is.na(risk$group)),
  !any(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d),
  all(
    risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d ==
      (risk$outcome_drafted_d | risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d)
  )
)
```

## 3. Results

### Offensive linemen are drafted most often and quarterbacks sit mid-table

```{r}
#| label: rates
rates <- risk |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    players = n_distinct(playerId),
    drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    drafted = drafted_ev / seasons,
    drafted_lo = 100 * wilson(drafted_ev, seasons)["lo"],
    drafted_hi = 100 * wilson(drafted_ev, seasons)["hi"]
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(desc(drafted))
rates_cmp <- comparable(rates) |>
  mutate(group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group)))
rate_of <- function(g) rates$drafted[rates$group == g]
ol_rate <- rate_of("Offensive line")
qb_rate <- rate_of("Quarterback")
st_rate <- rate_of("Special teams")
qb_rank <- which(rates_cmp$group == "Quarterback")
```

*Expecting quarterbacks to be the most draftable position.* ❌ The figure
ranks the nine groups by the share of eligible seasons that ended in a
draft pick: out of every 100 eligible seasons, about
`r round(100 * ol_rate)` offensive-line seasons end in a pick, against
`r round(100 * qb_rate)` for quarterbacks (rank `r qb_rank` of
`r nrow(rates_cmp)`) and `r round(100 * st_rate)` for specialists, a
`r sprintf("%.1f", ol_rate / st_rate)`-fold spread.

```{r}
#| label: rates-fig
#| fig-height: 6
ol_y <- which(levels(rates_cmp$group_f) == "Offensive line")
qb_y <- which(levels(rates_cmp$group_f) == "Quarterback")
ol_hi <- rates_cmp$drafted_hi[rates_cmp$group == "Offensive line"]
qb_hi <- rates_cmp$drafted_hi[rates_cmp$group == "Quarterback"]
p_rates <- ggplot(rates_cmp, aes(100 * drafted, group_f)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = group %in% c("Offensive line", "Quarterback"),
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %.1f%% drafted (%s of %s eligible seasons; 95%% CI %.1f%% to %.1f%%)",
        group,
        100 * drafted,
        fmt(drafted_ev),
        fmt(seasons),
        drafted_lo,
        drafted_hi
      ),
      data_id = group
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = drafted_lo, xmax = drafted_hi), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = drafted_hi + 0.3,
      label = sprintf(
        "%.1f%% (%s of %s)",
        100 * drafted,
        fmt(drafted_ev),
        fmt(seasons)
      )
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 11,
    y = ol_y - 1.7,
    label = "The top rate covers only the\nlinemen who left a stat line",
    size = 4.2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 12.5,
    y = ol_y - 1.25,
    xend = ol_hi + 0.2,
    yend = ol_y - 0.3,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 10,
    y = qb_y - 1.6,
    label = sprintf(
      "Quarterbacks rank %d of %d:\n%.1f%% of eligible seasons drafted",
      qb_rank,
      nrow(rates_cmp),
      100 * qb_rate
    ),
    size = 4.2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 10.8,
    y = qb_y - 1.1,
    xend = qb_hi + 4,
    yend = qb_y - 0.1,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = 18) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1B9E77", `FALSE` = "gray65")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "The drafted rate spans more than sixfold across positions",
    subtitle = "Share of eligible player-seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group",
    x = "Eligible seasons drafted",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Whiskers: 95% confidence interval. Labels: drafted seasons of eligible seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_rates, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: rates-guard
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  # The draft event stays rare inside every position group.
  all(rates$drafted < 0.10),
  # The claimed ordering: offensive line on top, special teams at the bottom,
  # quarterbacks mid-pack.
  rates$group[1] == "Offensive line",
  rates_cmp$group[nrow(rates_cmp)] == "Special teams",
  qb_rank == 5L,
  abs(ol_rate - 0.0823) < 0.0005,
  abs(qb_rate - 0.0369) < 0.0005,
  abs(st_rate - 0.0122) < 0.0005,
  ol_rate / st_rate > 6
)
```

### Drafted quarterbacks go in the first round more often than any other group

```{r}
#| label: round-mix
round_mix <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_drafted_d) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    drafted_seasons = n(),
    round1 = sum(outcome_draft_round_d == 1L),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(round1_share = round1 / drafted_seasons) |>
  arrange(desc(round1_share))
round_cmp <- comparable(round_mix) |>
  mutate(group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group)))
qb_r1 <- round_mix[round_mix$group == "Quarterback", ]
runner_up <- round_cmp[2, ]
cast_pick <- function(name, col) {
  risk[[col]][risk$player == name & risk$outcome_drafted_d]
}
burrow_pick <- cast_pick("Joe Burrow", "outcome_draft_pick_d")
ward_pick <- cast_pick("Cameron Ward", "outcome_draft_pick_d")
travis_round <- cast_pick("Jordan Travis", "outcome_draft_round_d")
travis_pick <- cast_pick("Jordan Travis", "outcome_draft_pick_d")
```

*Expecting first-round picks to concentrate among quarterbacks.* ✅ The
figure shows the share of each group's drafted seasons that went in round
1, where quarterbacks lead at `r pct(qb_r1$round1_share)`
(`r qb_r1$round1` of `r qb_r1$drafted_seasons`, Joe Burrow and Cameron
Ward among them, both taken first overall) against
`r pct(runner_up$round1_share)` for the next group,
`r tolower(runner_up$group)`, while Jordan Travis, a round-`r travis_round`
pick at `r travis_pick`, counts the same as Burrow in the drafted rate.

```{r}
#| label: round-fig
#| fig-height: 6
r1_qb_y <- which(levels(round_cmp$group_f) == "Quarterback")
p_round <- ggplot(round_cmp, aes(100 * round1_share, group_f)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = group == "Quarterback",
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %d of %d drafted seasons in round 1 (%.1f%%)",
        group,
        round1,
        drafted_seasons,
        100 * round1_share
      ),
      data_id = group
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf(
        "%.1f%% (%d of %d)",
        100 * round1_share,
        round1,
        drafted_seasons
      )
    ),
    hjust = -0.08,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 25,
    y = r1_qb_y - 2.4,
    label = "About one drafted quarterback\nin four goes in the first round",
    size = 4.2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 28,
    y = r1_qb_y - 1.9,
    xend = 100 * qb_r1$round1_share - 1,
    yend = r1_qb_y - 0.38,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = 40) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "gray65")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Quarterbacks claim the first round out of proportion",
    subtitle = "Share of each group's drafted seasons that were first-round picks",
    x = "Drafted seasons picked in round 1",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Labels: round-1 picks of drafted seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_round, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: round-guard
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  round_mix$group[1] == "Quarterback",
  qb_r1$round1 == 42L,
  qb_r1$drafted_seasons == 160L,
  round_mix$round1_share[1] > 0.25,
  round_mix$round1_share[1] >
    2 * round_mix$round1_share[round_mix$group == "Running back"],
  runner_up$group == "Defensive line",
  abs(runner_up$round1_share - 0.168) < 0.001,
  # The cast's pinned facts.
  burrow_pick == 1L,
  ward_pick == 1L,
  travis_round == 5L,
  travis_pick == 171L,
  all(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d[
    risk$player %in%
      c("Shane Buechele", "Kyle Allen") &
      risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d
  ])
)
```

### Quarterbacks carry the earliest average pick across classes, but not in most single classes

```{r}
#| label: pick-trend
pick_trend <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_drafted_d, !is.na(outcome_draft_pick_d)) |>
  group_by(group, draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    picks = n(),
    avg_pick = mean(outcome_draft_pick_d),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(picks >= 5) |>
  comparable()
pooled_pick <- mean(risk$outcome_draft_pick_d[
  risk$outcome_drafted_d & !is.na(risk$outcome_draft_pick_d)
])
complete_groups <- pick_trend |>
  count(group) |>
  filter(n == max(n)) |>
  pull(group)
group_means <- pick_trend |>
  filter(group %in% complete_groups) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(m = mean(avg_pick), .groups = "drop")
qb_avg_all <- group_means$m[group_means$group == "Quarterback"]
lowest_per_year <- pick_trend |>
  group_by(draft_year) |>
  slice_min(avg_pick, n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
n_classes <- nrow(lowest_per_year)
n_qb_lowest <- sum(lowest_per_year$group == "Quarterback")
qb_trend <- pick_trend |>
  filter(group == "Quarterback") |>
  mutate(
    lowest = draft_year %in%
      lowest_per_year$draft_year[lowest_per_year$group == "Quarterback"]
  )
```

*Expecting quarterbacks to be picked earliest on average, in every draft
class.* ❌ The figure traces each group's average overall pick by draft
class with quarterbacks in color: averaged over classes they sit at pick
`r round(qb_avg_all)`, the earliest of the `r length(complete_groups)`
groups with a cell in every class, yet they hold the earliest average in
only `r n_qb_lowest` of `r n_classes` classes, because a class hands each
position only a handful of picks.

```{r}
#| label: pick-fig
#| fig-height: 6
p_pick <- ggplot(pick_trend, aes(draft_year, avg_pick)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = pooled_pick, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line_interactive(
    data = filter(pick_trend, group != "Quarterback"),
    aes(group = group, tooltip = group, data_id = group),
    color = "gray75",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_line(data = qb_trend, color = "#D95F02", linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = qb_trend,
    aes(
      shape = lowest,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "Quarterbacks, %d: pick %.0f on average (%d picks)",
        draft_year,
        avg_pick,
        picks
      )
    ),
    color = "#D95F02",
    fill = "#D95F02",
    size = 3.4,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 21, `FALSE` = 1), guide = "none") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2012.2,
    y = 22,
    label = sprintf(
      "Filled points: the %d of %d classes where\nquarterbacks had the earliest average pick",
      n_qb_lowest,
      n_classes
    ),
    size = 4.2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 2017.6,
    y = 26,
    xend = 2020.8,
    yend = qb_trend$avg_pick[qb_trend$draft_year == 2021] - 6,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2012, 2025, by = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "The quarterback average swings by dozens of picks from class to class",
    subtitle = "Average overall pick among drafted seasons, by draft class (lower is earlier)",
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Average overall pick",
    caption = sprintf(
      "Orange: quarterbacks. Gray: the other position groups (hover for names). Dashed line: all drafted seasons, pick %.0f. Group-class cells with fewer than 5 picks omitted.",
      pooled_pick
    )
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_pick, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: pick-guard
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  # Quarterbacks carry the lowest long-run average pick among the groups
  # with a published cell in every draft class.
  group_means$group[which.min(group_means$m)] == "Quarterback",
  qb_avg_all < 120,
  length(complete_groups) == 6L,
  # But not in every class: the yearly minimum changes hands.
  n_qb_lowest == 5L,
  n_classes == 14L,
  # The annotation's arrow targets the 2021 quarterback point.
  qb_trend$lowest[qb_trend$draft_year == 2021],
  min(pick_trend$avg_pick) > 45,
  # The dashed reference line in the figure is the pooled average pick.
  abs(pooled_pick - 126.6) < 0.05
)
```

### Quarterbacks and offensive linemen are the only groups whose entrants mostly arrive drafted

```{r}
#| label: udfa-share
udfa_share <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    entrants = n(),
    udfa = sum(outcome_signed_udfa_d),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(share = udfa / entrants) |>
  arrange(desc(share))
udfa_cmp <- comparable(udfa_share) |>
  mutate(
    group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group)),
    route = if_else(share < 0.5, "Mostly drafted", "Mostly undrafted")
  )
udfa_of <- function(g) udfa_share$share[udfa_share$group == g]
qb_udfa <- udfa_of("Quarterback")
ol_udfa <- udfa_of("Offensive line")
st_udfa <- udfa_of("Special teams")
overall_udfa <- mean(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d[risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d])
```

*Expecting quarterbacks to arrive through the draft while other positions
lean on the undrafted route.* ✅ Among the seasons that ended in NFL entry,
the figure shows the share that arrived as an undrafted free agent (UDFA, a
player signed after going unpicked): `r pct(qb_udfa)` for quarterbacks
and `r pct(ol_udfa)` for offensive linemen fall below half, against
`r pct(overall_udfa)` across all entrants and `r pct(st_udfa)` for
specialists.

```{r}
#| label: udfa-fig

ud_qb_y <- which(levels(udfa_cmp$group_f) == "Quarterback")

  ) +

girafe(ggobj = p_udfa, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: udfa-guard
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  udfa_share$group[1] == "Special teams",
  udfa_share$group[nrow(udfa_share)] == "Quarterback",
  setequal(
    udfa_cmp$group[udfa_cmp$share < 0.5],
    c("Quarterback", "Offensive line")
  ),
  abs(qb_udfa - 0.435) < 0.001,
  abs(ol_udfa - 0.481) < 0.001,
  abs(st_udfa - 0.686) < 0.001,
  abs(overall_udfa - 0.566) < 0.001,
  # The annotation sits between the two mostly-drafted bars at the bottom.
  ud_qb_y == 1L,
  ud_ol_y == 2L
)
```

## 4. Summary

```{r}
#| label: summary-nums
#| include: false
n_ol_players <- rates$players[rates$group == "Offensive line"]
n_nr <- rates$seasons[rates$group == "Position not recorded"]
nr <- filter(risk, group == "Position not recorded")
nr_placeholder <- sum(nr$position %in% "?" & nr$draft_year <= 2018)
nr_no_row <- sum(is.na(nr$position) & nr$draft_year %in% 2021:2022)
stopifnot(
  n_ol_players == 806L,
  n_nr == 869L,
  # The caveat's description of the not-recorded group.
  (nr_placeholder + nr_no_row) / n_nr > 0.85
)
```

+ The drafted rate spans from `r pct(ol_rate)` of eligible offensive-line
  seasons down to `r pct(st_rate)` for special teams; quarterbacks sit
  mid-table at `r pct(qb_rate)`.
+ Drafted quarterbacks are first-round picks `r pct(qb_r1$round1_share)`
  of the time, well ahead of any other group.
+ Quarterbacks carry the earliest average pick across classes
  (`r round(qb_avg_all)`) among the groups with a cell in every class, but
  are the earliest group in only `r n_qb_lowest` of `r n_classes` classes.
+ Quarterbacks and offensive linemen are the only groups whose NFL entrants
  mostly arrive drafted (`r pct(1 - qb_udfa)` and `r pct(1 - ol_udfa)`
  drafted); for specialists the undrafted route carries
  `r pct(st_udfa)`.

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important appearance="minimal"}
**The offensive line rate describes a selected group, not linemen in
general.**

- This population requires a stat line, and linemen rarely appear in one.
- The `r fmt(n_ol_players)` linemen in the risk set recovered a fumble,
  caught a deflection, or otherwise left a statistical trace, and their
  `r pct(ol_rate)` drafted rate describes that minority; models should
  treat the line as a thin-data category.
:::

::: {.callout-important appearance="minimal"}
**Position is a feature the models should carry.**

- Both the level (a more than sixfold spread in drafted rates) and the
  shape (round mix, average pick, entry route) differ by position.
- A single pooled model would spend its capacity explaining variance that
  position names in one column.
:::

Two caveats bound the figures. The not-recorded group holds
`r fmt(n_nr)` seasons, `r pct(n_nr / n_risk)` of the risk set, mostly
placeholder codes in the 2012 to 2018 classes and missing roster rows in
the 2021 and 2022 classes; it is counted in the risk set but left out of
the comparisons. And the eligibility-clock imputation noted in the
previous post applies here: high-school graduation year is imputed for
players without a recruiting record, shifting rows in and out of the risk
set; the shifts are not position-specific, so the between-group
comparisons are sturdier than the absolute levels.
